include.description: Globs (relative to the root) of sources to mutate.

since.description: Git ref: only run mutants inside `git diff <since>`.

scope.description: Diff granularity: changed nodes, or whole enclosing functions.

runner.description: Test runner; auto picks vitest or jest from config files and installed packages.

vitestConfig.description: Vitest config file, relative to the root.

jestConfig.description: Jest config file, relative to the root (experimental, native ESM only).

arid.description: Arid (logging-only) code suppression: false runs those mutants too; callees replaces the logging call patterns.

experimentalCallgraph.description: Re-run only survivors connected to changed code in the static call graph.

fullDryRun.description: Collect coverage from every test file.

reportDir.description: Where json/html reports go, relative to the root.

high.description: Score at or above which the result is high (default 80).

low.description: Score at or above which the result is low; below is danger (default 60).

break.description: Exit 2 when the score is below this (default null: never).

plugins.description: Plugin modules (relative paths or package names) providing custom mutators.

excludedMutators.description: Mutators to skip, built-in or custom, by name.

mutantsPerLine.description: Run at most this many mutants per source line, most productive mutators first (default: unlimited).

timeBudget.description: Seconds from the start of the run after which no new mutant run starts; the rest stay pending (default: unlimited).
